title: Don't Forget Your ABC's: Evaluating the State-of-the-Art in Chat-Oriented Dialogue Systems
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study. A brief, incidental mention of 'church' occurred in one of the example dialogues but was not analyzed.
